nominal: DESIGN-NOMINAL: c_128 900 counter cycles (design-tile 2.2's mid value), F_wg the R3 tile's CAL 520 / 979, accounting W, F-step, A key CLAMP; for levers, sensitivities and power only, never a registered prediction

E1-TILE (primary, D2).statistic: e = T_v4 / T_meas - 1 per valid NATIVE cell (all six labels), v4 from predicted bytes at the finalised constants; NATIVE has no term (b) and its dead term is about 1 to 2 us
E1-TILE (primary, D2).rule: HOLDS iff the POOLED NATIVE cells AND each BLIND-TILE model's (Phi, Qwen1.5, JetMoE; D4: 'each shape' is each model) meet rms <= 2%, worst <= 5%, |mean| <= 1%, in each view; the registered verdict holds only if ALL and CLEAN hold
E1-TILE (primary, D2).deepseek-v2-lite (design-tile-review 9.6: in the pooled bar; its own bar is printed DESCRIPTIVE (one page: it can never be CERTIFIED); dropped (dsv), it leaves the pool
E1-TILE (primary, D2).certification: a BLIND-TILE model is CERTIFIED in CLEAN with its cells meeting the bar and at least 2 of its pages in CLEAN (Phi 3 pages, Qwen1.5 2, JetMoE 2: jg1 and qg16 are nodrop for this)
E1-TILE (primary, D2).a model left with one page: its bar is scored and it is NOT CERTIFIED
E1-TILE (primary, D2).a model left with no valid cell (build-t: E1-TILE reads NOT SCORED (incomplete), not FAILS, unless the pool or another blind model fails
E1-TILE (primary, D2).G3_void: a strict G3 FAIL voids every histogram cell: E1-TILE NOT SCORED, printed DESCRIPTIVELY

tests.E1-TILE-S (secondary): SHARED cells, v4 + term (b) as v3 (the page's own A) + the v2 dead term; the same bar; a registered verdict that certifies nothing
tests.E2-TILE: NATIVE time from the byte pages' counted bytes (v4's timing alone) on the cells both pages carry; rental 6's E2 bar (rms <= 2%, worst <= 5%, |mean| <= 1.5%)
tests.B-BYTES: byte rows of the byte pages under the finalised key: rms <= 3% and every row <= 5% (B-SKEW's bar), per GEMM
tests.G3: rental 7's TOST on uniform minus balanced (clusters the pages, margin 0.36%), strict

rivals.v3own: v3 at its own constants, only the geometry moving (c 344.1, R3's PHI)
rivals.roofline: T0 + sum over GEMMs of max(flops / (4096 x eta_mma x 132 x L), bytes / bw), L A2's lock (1.71, 1.41 or 1.305 GHz)
rivals.OLS (design-tile-review 9.10): ONE ridge regression over every valid NATIVE E1-CAL cell of rental A (classes pooled): T = a + b waves + c bytes / bw + d ln(1 + CTAs), waves = sum over GEMMs of live CTAs / (132 x occ), bytes v4's predicted, CTAs live over both GEMMs; standardised features, ridge lambda 1e-3 x trace(X'X) / 3, intercept unpenalised; NOT SCORED under 12 cells or when the standardised X'X has condition number over 1e6; frozen at finalisation
rivals.unselected accountings, F-cyc, eta_mma r: tileA-floor's lever counts: NOT SEPARATED by construction under 6 lever cells
rivals.v4cal: NOT SEPARATED by construction (the same model at 128x128)
rivals.exclusion rule: on lever cells (|T_R / T_v4 - 1| >= 2%, at least 6): R's rms over 2% and over v4's rms + 3 se, se = sigma_page / sqrt(cells) (tcommon.rival_rule)

split views (DESCRIPTIVE).G-16 cells: E1 on the 128 G 16 cells alone (the floor law)
split views (DESCRIPTIVE).G-1 n-1 cells: E1 on the G 1 n 1 cells alone (the byte model at G 1)

gates.G2 host (design-tile-review 9.7): rental 3's registered rule, T + F240 < 0.40 ms is host-bound, on the FINALISED prediction (after rental A's selections), AND the timer flag; the design's 0.3324 ms was a design-script threshold, never registered
gates.G4: cell clock >= L - 5 MHz (L A2's lock: 1705, 1405 or 1300)
gates.tile: the page's recorded tile is the unit's
gates.census (tileA-census): a (model, tile) whose rental-B2 census occupancy differs from A2's merged census (tileA2-census): NOT SCORED

power.model: design-tile-review work/power_rb075.py's, re-run on the registered 84 cells (power_tile.py): ln(T_meas / T_v4) = common-mode tile bias + model-specific bias + cell 0.6% + bytes 1.75% x dln T / dln B (each cell's, DESIGN-NOMINAL) + page 0.18% + board 0.26%
power.reading: P(E1-TILE) rests on the model-specific drift, which no rental-A page can bound for a blind model; the common-mode part is what the stop rule catches

labels.uniform and balanced: per row: SEEN-WORKLOAD where a published page timed the counts

scorer_ambiguities.1 which c is the denominator, and F's un: c_time = c_card x c_counter(tile) / 344.1 (344.1 the CAL counters' c); F is held in counter cycles and PHI = F / c_counter(tile) in k-steps; at R3's tile v4 is v3 exactly (r3_timing_model_v4.py --check)
scorer_ambiguities.2 F-cyc against F-step: F-step (v3's form) is registered; F-cyc replaces it only when, on the 64x128 w8 pages, it is nearer the measured F on both GEMMs and F-step misses by more than 3 se on one (tcommon.f_form_rule)
scorer_ambiguities.3 eta_mma: per clock (Luo Table 11, 0.991), per instruction by Table 9's ratios: 0.983 (m64n128k16, 128x128 w8), 0.965 (m64n64k16, 64x128); H800 PCIe, FP16; BF16 on GH200 assumed equal; rival Table 9's chip-relative 0.872 / 0.857
scorer_ambiguities.4 tA-floor: the test statistic is u = S c + F per (model, GEMM), within 3%; cells are the NATIVE and SHARED cells at n 4..9 whose own GEMM reads DRAM at no more than 0.5 x 4022 GB/s; a dropped w4 page changes nothing (printed only); at 128x128 v4cal and v4 are the same model
scorer_ambiguities.5 the NAMED rule's rows, and the default: every scored w1 row of the G-1 byte pages (uniform, balanced and skewed, NATIVE and SHARED); nothing NAMED gives CLAMP, not v3
scorer_ambiguities.6 E1-TILE's 'each model': the three BLIND-TILE models; deepseek-v2-lite is in the pooled bar only (its own bar DESCRIPTIVE, never CERTIFIED); a model left with one page is scored and NOT CERTIFIED
scorer_ambiguities.7 the host cut: 0.40 ms (T + F240), rental 3's registered rule, on the FINALISED v4 prediction
scorer_ambiguities.8 tA-rep dropped: rental 3's 0.18% feeds the rivals' se, tA-dead's z and the power at finalisation
scorer_ambiguities.9 tA-e1cal 'fails': on the CLEAN view: the pooled NATIVE bar, each class mean within 0.75%, the 128 G 1 CAL models within 1%; a SKIPPED, LOST or NOT SCORED E1-CAL page, or a G3 void, is a STOP (tileB-stop)
scorer_ambiguities.10 the OLS rival: one ridge OLS over every valid NATIVE E1-CAL cell (features waves, bytes / bw, ln(1 + CTAs); lambda 1e-3 x trace(X'X) / 3 on standardised features); NOT SCORED under 12 cells or condition number over 1e6
scorer_ambiguities.11 census against counter occupancy: integers, exact; a counter page at another occupancy is scored at its recorded one (rental 4's re-key, score_floor: Z_wg at the 128x128 pages' recorded occupancy, each 64x128 page's c at its own); on rental B a (model, tile) at another occupancy than rental A's census is NOT SCORED on every page of that (model, tile), and a missing or refused rental-B census leaves every page NOT SCORED (score_tileB.census_check); a refused rental-A census is a STOP
scorer_ambiguities.12 tA-dead: tread n 1 (uniform and balanced); align growth = (A_S - A_N) at c15 minus at c9 off each page's align_probe; se = 2 sigma_page mean(T) / sqrt(cells), sigma_page tA-rep's or 0.18%
scorer_ambiguities.13 the 30 MiB row key: one of the card's two L2 partitions of its measured 60 MiB (rental 4's rulers, CONSISTENT with RRZE's GH200; Hopper's partitioned L2, NVIDIA H100 whitepaper); the 'Fan et al.' attribution is withdrawn
scorer_ambiguities.14 byte pages and timed pages: one histogram file per (model, tile, G): a byte page and a timed page of the same (model, tile, G) read the same file, so their counts are identical (the files' sha256 above)

lock.decision (owner, 2026-10-20): a 900 W GPU power limit (GPU scope, -sc 0) and the lock ladder 1710, 1410, 1305 MHz: the probe tries 1710 first; the first rung whose probe passes is the run's lock
lock.changes: the owner's 2026-09-26 decision (the GPU power limit 700 W at the start, -sc 0) FOR TILE RENTAL A2 AND RENTAL B2 ONLY (B2 runs at the limit and the lock rung A2 held, read from A2's score directory); every other rental's driver keeps 700 W
lock.why (DESIGN-A2 1, REVIEW-A2 1): rental A's wgmma pages sagged under the 1710 lock: reason 0x4 (SW power cap) only, 60 C at most; the smi trace went to 1290 MHz on the three heavy 128x128 pages; the inferred cause is the software power cap (GPU or module scope unresolved), so the limit rises to the card's maximum and the lock steps down only when the probe says the cap still bites
lock.ladder (owner, 2026-10-20): 1710, then 1410, then 1305 MHz: the lock-hold probe's first rung that holds is A2's lock (tileA2-gates G-PROBE). At 1710 no clock conversion is used (v4L is v4 exactly) and CONV-L does not run; 1410 and 1305 carry the conversion
lock.conversion risk at 1410 and 1305 (build: the offline check (tileA2-convl) reads v3's c-only conversion about 1.36% fast on R1's G 1 cells at 1410 (clock-attributable, the level cancelled), and about 1.4x that at 1305 (ln(1710/1305) / ln(1710/1410)); against tileB2-stop's 0.75% class-mean clause, a 64 G 1 or 128 G 1 class at those rungs can STOP on the carried constants, not the wgmma calibration (SEEN-expected, stated before any page)
